findings.message: "#regla" starts hidden, but its gsap.fromTo() makes it visible only in the from-vars and omits opacity/autoAlpha from the destination. Cold render workers restore the hidden authored state, so the encoded element can stay invisible even when sequential snapshots look correct.
findings.fixHint: Add `opacity: 1` (or `autoAlpha: 1`) to the destination vars for "#regla" so every seek path establishes the visible end state explicitly.

findings.message: 3 tl.fromTo() calls target "#ofi-cam" with no stable baseline. The last-authored fromTo "from" values become the element's resting state for any seek before the first tween actually runs, because GSAP applies fromTo from-values at authoring time (immediateRender), not at tween position.
findings.fixHint: Add `immediateRender: false` to every fromTo except the earliest-positioned one (at 0s), so pre-first-tween seeks keep its "from" values. A hiding `tl.set(..., 0)` baseline trips gsap_timeline_set_initial_hide, and a `gsap.set` authored before the fromTo calls is overwritten by them.

findings.message: 2 tl.fromTo() calls target "#imac-prog" with no stable baseline. The last-authored fromTo "from" values become the element's resting state for any seek before the first tween actually runs, because GSAP applies fromTo from-values at authoring time (immediateRender), not at tween position.
findings.fixHint: Add `immediateRender: false` to every fromTo except the earliest-positioned one (at 0.8s), so pre-first-tween seeks keep its "from" values. A hiding `tl.set(..., 0)` baseline trips gsap_timeline_set_initial_hide, and a `gsap.set` authored before the fromTo calls is overwritten by them.
